tasks.label: Build TempoSample Editor
args: $build = Join-Path $env:UNREAL_ENGINE_PATH 'Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat'; if (-not (Test-Path $build)) { throw 'UNREAL_ENGINE_PATH is missing or does not point to an Unreal Engine installation.' }; & $build TempoSampleEditor Development Win64 '-Project=${workspaceFolder}\TempoSample.uproject' -WaitMutex -FromMsBuild -NoUBA
